title: Cottage Cheese Omelette
subtitle: high-protein and filling
description: A fluffy, cheesy omelette made with just eggs and cottage cheese, fried in a small pan.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs and cottage cheese together in a bowl with a little salt.
Heat a pan with a little oil (best results come from a 20 cm pan).
Pour the egg and cottage cheese mixture into the pan and fry over low-medium heat until set enough to flip.
Flip and fry for about 1 minute on the other side.
